QuestInfo.name: The Start of Something New 2
QuestInfo.0: You met with Athena Pierce. It looks like Fenelle gave her a heads up, since she seemed to be expecting your arrival.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce told you that many people in Maple World could really use a helping hand. In fact, she has one such request for you right now.
QuestInfo.2: You looked over the request you received, but as you did, you also got the impression that the Taotie has something to say about all of this.
